 Al Roker Calls Carson Daly's Microphone Fix Awkward on TODAY
 Emily Johnson

 A microphone problem prompted an unexpected on-air embrace between weather reporter Al Roker and co-anchor Carson Daly during the October 19, 2026, broadcast of NBC's TODAY. Daly attempted to help Roker overcome the technical issue, but the improvised solution left Roker joking about the awkward moment in front of their fellow anchors.
 According to reports published by Yahoo and HELLO! Magazine, Roker was adjusting his microphone when Daly stepped away from the desk to assist. The two were on the morning program when Daly tried an unconventional approach to make Roker's voice audible.
 Advertisement 
 Scroll To Continue with Content 
 Daly hugged Roker tightly so the weather reporter's voice could be picked up by Daly's microphone. Roker's own microphone was quickly fixed, allowing Daly to release him and the broadcast to continue.

 Roker responded to the unexpected contact with a brief remark that drew attention to the unusual interaction.
 "That was awkward," said Al Roker, weather reporter on TODAY.
 Co-anchors Savannah Guthrie and Sheinelle Jones watched the exchange from the desk. Jones was filling in for Craig Melvin during the broadcast, according to the reports.

 The incident offered a brief, unscripted moment during the long-running morning news program. Both Yahoo and HELLO! Magazine described the exchange as an awkward embrace prompted by Roker's microphone trouble, with the technical issue resolved shortly afterward.
